scope: Independent cross-review of root decision and preserved ranking input; review of comparator logic against lane primary sources, without re-running scientific or financial models.

resolved_issues.original_issue: The envelope is reinterpreted as possibly qualification-only while conditional rank4 is retained. Existing text reprices expansion, but does not explicitly deny inheritance of the old rank when information yield falls without a cost increase.
resolved_issues.resolution: Both decision files now explicitly deny automatic rank4/EV inheritance for qualification-only scope and require re-comparison for reduced information yield even when price is unchanged; branchB6 and structured flags agree.

open_issues.issue: Article/exposure and patent/current-program factual assertions depend on their separate source audits and cross-reviews; this decision review does not constitute a fresh exhaustive patent claim or primary-method review.
open_issues.required_resolution: Integrate completed lane reviews and preserve their qualifications before publication.

open_issues.issue: No price, timeline, executable complete scope, rights terms or numerical financial EV is verified.
open_issues.required_resolution: Retain explicit assumptions and stage/recomparison limits.
